text:
Anna Park: Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem on the authz outage. I captured the action items and wanted to confirm owners + realistic ETAs so we can close the loop. @security-team please weigh in.

Raj Singh: Thanks Anna. Can we list owners and target dates here so I can add them to the sprint board?

Maria Gonzalez: I can own the token validation hardening. Plan: add stricter validation paths, unit + integ tests, and add a failing test for the previous regression. ETA: Fri 2026-03-27 EOD. I'll create the draft PR and post link. :white_check_mark:

Kevin Cho: I'll take audit logging improvements — make token failure logs structured and include token_reason + issuer + request_id. Also add retention and index keys so search is cheap. ETA: Tue 2026-03-31. Will update schema PR.

Jen Morales: SRE will add monitoring/alerting. Proposed alert: token_validation_error_rate > 0.5% over 10m for ANY service. Also create dashboard with filter by service and endpoint. I'll add pager rule to sev2 if rate spikes for 5m.

Opsbot: Reminder scheduled: run secrets scan in prod tomorrow 03/24 02:00 UTC. Command: `./scripts/secrets-scan --env prod --fix-ignored`

Anna Park: Quick checklist to confirm: 1) Token validation code + tests (Maria) 2) Structured authz logs (Kevin) 3) Alert + dashboard + pager (Jen) 4) Secrets scan + rotation plan (Opsbot / security team) 5) Postmortem runbook update (me)

Raj Singh: Noted. Two additional items: add an automated smoke test that exercises token validation on deploy, and add an audit job that samples 1% of auth failures and stores details for 30d. Who wants the smoke test?

Maria Gonzalez: I can add the smoke test to the CI pipeline — will target Mon 2026-03-30 for the test to be green on main. Smoke test will run against staging tokens and assert failure/success paths.

Kevin Cho: I'll wire the sampled audit job. Implementation: small Kinesis stream -> lambda consumer -> secure S3 bucket (encrypted) with 30d lifecycle. I'll document the schema in the PR.

Jen Morales: I'll add the alert rule today. Draft alert (prometheus style):
```
alert: TokenValidationErrorRateHigh
expr: sum(rate(auth_token_validation_failures[10m])) / sum(rate(auth_requests_total[10m])) > 0.005
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "Token validation failure rate > 0.5% ({{ $labels.service }})"
```
I'll post the Grafana dashboard link when ready.

Anna Park: Note on recurring pattern: this is the 3rd authz-related regression in ~6 weeks (tokens + audit gaps). Raj/leadership — we should consider a monthly authz health run (eng + security review) and add this as a recurring checklist.

Raj Singh: Agree. Please create a recurring calendar and a lightweight checklist. Propose 30m sync every 2 weeks until we see 2 clean runs.

Maria Gonzalez: One risk: rotating legacy tokens may surface more errors. I'll flag in the PR and add a migration plan with a rollback toggle.

Anna Park: I'll open the tracking issue and link all PRs: PM-3456 (Authz follow-ups). I'll add owners & ETAs, and mark items for this sprint. Everyone: paste PR links here when opened.

Kevin Cho: PR opened for logging schema: https://git.internal/redwood/pull/8123 (WIP) — will update by EOD Mon.

Maria Gonzalez: Draft PR for validation tests will be up by Thu morning.

Jen Morales: Alert + dashboard PR: https://git.internal/redwood/pull/8130 — ready for review.

Opsbot: Scheduled job created: secrets-scan-prod-20260324.

Anna Park: Great. I'll update the runbook with explicit rollback steps and where to look in logs for token failures. Next checkpoint: Wed 2026-03-25 10:30am PT — brief sync to confirm progress. If anything slips, call it out here. :eyes:
